dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Terokai susunan jahitan, warna benang, lompatan, pemangkasan, dan arahan mesin sebelum pengeluaran. Pratonton reka bentuk jahitan demi jahitan, tukar gaya pemaparan, dan eksport apa yang anda lihat.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Simulasi sulaman interaktif, pemeriksaan, dan eksport.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Letakkan pembaris pada skrin dan seret peluncur sehingga bar di bawah tepat 100 mm, kemudian tekan OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Salin imej resolusi penuh ke papan klip

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Bahasa telah ditetapkan kepada {language}. Mulakan semula InkSim sekarang untuk menggunakannya?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Bahasa lalai sistem akan digunakan. Mulakan semula InkSim sekarang untuk menggunakannya?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Semua tetingkap InkSim yang dibuka akan ditutup dan fail semasa dibuka semula.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Pratonton jahitan mengambil masa terlalu lama.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Buka SVG ini dalam tetingkap Inkscape baharu.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Tiada fail yang disokong dalam folder ini.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Klik dua kali folder untuk menyemak imbas failnya.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Klik dua kali folder untuk menyemak imbas failnya.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape diperlukan untuk mengedit fail SVG.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Pemasangan Ink/Stitch yang dikonfigurasikan dan pelancar Python diperlukan.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Jana data jahitan daripada SVG ini menggunakan Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Tidak dapat menjalankan skrip Ink/Stitch yang aktif atau pelancar Python yang dikonfigurasikan.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Sambungan Ink/Stitch: tidak dapat diperiksa. Gunakan Alat... untuk mencuba lagi.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Sambungan Ink/Stitch: tidak ditemui dalam direktori sambungan Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Sambungan Ink/Stitch: tidak dapat diperiksa sebelum Inkscape dikonfigurasikan.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Sambungan Ink/Stitch: belum diperiksa. Gunakan Alat... untuk memeriksa.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; editing requires Inkscape.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.translation: Pratonton SVG dijalankan terus melalui Ink/Stitch; pengeditan memerlukan Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; Inkscape is used only for editing.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.translation: Pratonton SVG dijalankan terus melalui Ink/Stitch; Inkscape hanya digunakan untuk pengeditan.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Sumber SVG. Inkscape diperlukan untuk pratonton jahitan.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Sumber SVG. Pilih Pratonton untuk menjana data jahitan dengan Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: SVG ini terlalu besar untuk dipratonton di sini.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Tidak dapat mencipta fail pratonton sementara: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Jenis fail ini tidak dapat dibuka dalam InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Tidak dapat menyimpan status sambungan Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa folder sambungan Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_user_current.translation: Sambungan pengguna semasa (sasaran pemasangan/kemas kini): {path} | Status: {status}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Tidak dapat memasang sambungan Inkscape InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Sambungan Inkscape InkSim telah dipasang atau dikemas kini di {path}. Mulakan semula Inkscape untuk memuatkannya.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape tidak ditemui dalam laluan sistem.

integration.inkscape.preferences_write_f.translation: Tidak dapat mengemas kini keutamaan Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Tidak dapat membaca direktori sambungan Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Mulakan semula Inkscape untuk menggunakan pentafsir Python yang baharu.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Tidak dapat membuang folder sambungan InkSim lama: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Folder sambungan InkSim lama telah dibuang. Mulakan semula Inkscape untuk memuat semula senarai sambungannya.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Persediaan yang dikesan telah disimpan dalam konfigurasi InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa folder sambungan InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Pelancar '{command}' yang diperlukan tidak ditemui; keutamaan tidak diubah.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape tidak ditemui. Pilih fail boleh laksananya untuk memeriksa persediaan.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa atau mengemas kini pentafsir Python: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Keutamaan pentafsir Python tidak diperiksa kerana direktori sambungan pengguna tidak tersedia.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Mulakan semula Inkscape untuk menggunakan pentafsir yang dikemas kini.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape tidak memberikan respons dalam masa {seconds} saat.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Pilih fail boleh laksana Inkscape untuk memeriksa.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape tidak memberikan respons dalam masa {seconds} saat. Instance Inkscape lain atau sambungan mungkin menghalang komunikasi. Tutup instance Inkscape lain atau nyahdayakan sambungan yang menghalang, kemudian cuba lagi.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Pelancar '{command}' yang diperlukan tidak ditemui. Pasang alat uvr sendiri dengan `uv tool install uvr`, kemudian jalankan konfigurasi ini sekali lagi. InkSim tidak akan memasangnya.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Tiada fail sulaman dimuatkan untuk dieksport.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Set semula lebar garisan dan faktor lorekan

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Klik untuk laraskan faktor gelap, faktor terang dan lebar garisan

status.mode.background.translation: Kitar latar belakang: hitam, putih, dikonfigurasi

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Paparan bawah (lukis jahitan kemudian di bawah jahitan awal)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Kitar paparan lompat: mati, semua, berisiko sahaja
